note: READY means every structural condition below is verified by this gate AND each listed proof exists and is registered in the quality gate. It is a statement about the CITIZEN SUBMIT FRONT DOOR only — it is NOT a statement of overall production readiness: the wider platform's proofs (Kafka behaviour, dead-letter/outbox delivery, MinIO/ClamAV forensics, the full isolation SQL, the multi-service dev boot) run in scripts/run-selfchecks.sh and are out of this gate's scope. The live proofs themselves run there too; if any of them cannot run (infrastructure unavailable), this signal reverts to BLOCKED — a skipped proof is not a passing one. Public contract: the browser sends Idempotency-Key; the edge answers 201, or 200 with Idempotency-Replayed: true on replay.
